page.title: PPE Requests
page.description: View every employee's requests in one queue, resolve group requests to the correct size/SKU, and send them for preparation.
page.empty: No PPE request was found in this tab.

tabDescriptions.pending: Requests with open lines not linked to an active preparation task. Managers can assign line by line; warehouse staff can claim.
tabDescriptions.preparing: Requests with preparation tasks in progress. Expand a row to manage its tasks.
tabDescriptions.completed: Requests whose delivery is completed. Track ERP status here.
tabDescriptions.mine: Active tasks you claimed or that were assigned to you. Double-click to start picking.
tabDescriptions.quotapending: Queue of lines that exceed entitlement. Approving/rejecting does not delete the request; when no pending quota remains it leaves this list and stays in Pending or In preparation.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel request
cancelDialog.description: PPE request {{no}} will be cancelled. Provide the cancellation reason.
cancelDialog.blockedTitle: This request cannot be cancelled right now
cancelDialog.goToOutbound: Go to the linked warehouse outbound

prepareDialog.title: Prepare request
prepareDialog.description: Distribute the lines of request {{no}} to people or a warehouse. You can approve quota-exceeding lines or exclude them from this round.
prepareDialog.assignHint: Select lines from the unassigned list, choose Person or Warehouse, then press 'Assign selected'.
prepareDialog.userSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, username or email
prepareDialog.prepWarehouseHint: Lines assigned to a person are prepared in this warehouse.
prepareDialog.poolWarehouseHint: Goes to that warehouse pool; staff there see it under My work.
prepareDialog.allAssignedHint: All lines are assigned. Use 'Confirm assignment' to save.
prepareDialog.remainingLines: {{count}} lines remain unassigned. All lines other than excluded ones must be assigned to save.
prepareDialog.needGroup: Create at least one assignment group to save.
prepareDialog.needTarget: Select a person or warehouse to assign the selected lines.
prepareDialog.allLinesRequired: All open lines that are not excluded must be assigned before saving.
prepareDialog.nothingToAssign: There are no open lines to assign on this request.
prepareDialog.quotaRejected: Rejected — will not be assigned this round
prepareDialog.quotaRejectedHint: This decision was recorded; go to the Quota Approvals screen to undo it.
prepareDialog.quotaNeedsManager: Manager permission is required to decide.
prepareDialog.quotaConfirmReject: This line will not be assigned this round, are you sure?

handoff.title: Hand over remaining work
handoff.description: Task {{no}} is currently owned by {{user}}. The unprepared remainder will be handed over to the selected user.
handoff.remainingInfo: {{count}} lines can be handed over. Prepared work stays on the current task.

expanded.noTasks: No preparation task has been created yet. Tasks appear here once assignment is made.
expanded.taskPool: In warehouse pool · unowned, anyone can claim it

empty.all: This request has no lines to show.
empty.excess: This request has no quota-exceeding lines.

quotaReview.approvedOverride: Quota approval was saved and extra entitlement was created for this line.
quotaReview.approvedLeftQueue: Quota approved. The request left this queue because no pending quota remains — it was not deleted; look under Pending or In preparation.
quotaReview.rejectedLeftQueue: Quota rejected. The request left this queue because no pending quota remains — it was not deleted.
quotaReview.decideFailed: The quota decision could not be saved.
quotaReview.approveReason: Approved from the Quota Approvals screen.
quotaReview.rejectDescription: Line {{group}} / {{stock}} will be rejected. Provide a reason.
quotaReview.rejectPlaceholder: Explain why this line is rejected

create.title: New PPE request
create.description: Select an exact SKU/size directly, or pick only the PPE group if the size is unknown. Choosing a group filters the stock list.
create.linesHelp: Add lines by group or by exact SKU. Selecting a SKU fills the group automatically; with a group only, SKU stays optional.
create.groupLookupDescription: Search by code or name. Use the search icon or double-click to open the full list.
create.stockOptional: Leave empty if the size is unknown; warehouse can resolve it later. You can also pick a SKU directly.
create.stockLookupDescription: Search all PPE stock. If a group is selected, the list is filtered. Double-click for the full list.
create.stockLookupDescriptionFiltered: Search stock in group {{group}}. Double-click for the full list.

detail.title: PPE request detail
detail.description: Manage request, SKU/size resolution and preparation progress by line.
detail.stockAwaiting: Exact SKU/size has not been selected
detail.noTasks: No preparation tasks yet. Tasks appear here after assignment.
detail.cancelReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this request is cancelled

resolve.title: Select SKU / size
resolve.description: Select the exact stock item to issue for group {{group}}.
resolve.stockHelp: Only items belonging to the request's PPE group are listed.
resolve.stockPlaceholder: Search by code, name or size

assign.title: Assign request
assign.description: Link request {{no}} to a warehouse and, optionally, a user.
assign.claimDescription: Select a preparation warehouse to claim request {{no}} for yourself.
assign.warehouseRestrictedHint: Only warehouses you're authorized for are listed.
assign.userHint: Leave empty to keep the request open for the warehouse without a specific owner.
assign.needWarehouse: A warehouse is required to claim the request.

validation.employeeAndLine: Select an employee and at least one line (group or stock).
validation.groupRequired: Each line needs a PPE group. If you picked a SKU, choose one with a group or select the group manually.
validation.quantity: All quantities must be greater than zero.
validation.reason: Operation reason must contain at least three characters.

messages.claimed: Request was claimed for you. Start preparation from the 'My work' tab.
messages.claimedPool: The task was claimed from the warehouse pool.
messages.taskNotFound: No active preparation task was found.
messages.reactivated: PPE request was put back to pending.
messages.failed: PPE operation could not be completed.
messages.detailFailed: Request detail could not be loaded.
